headline: Product-led growth accelerates, outlook raised
summary_short: F5 reported Q2 FY2026 revenue of $865.1M, up 10.9% y/y and 6.6% q/q, driven by 19% product revenue growth; diluted EPS of $3.62 rose 11.4% y/y and 40.3% q/q.
summary_long: Revenue of $865.1M (+10.9% y/y, +6.6% q/q) was driven by 19% product revenue growth — Systems +32% y/y to $240M, Software +7% y/y to $223M — while Services grew 3% y/y to $402M. GAAP gross margin held near 82.2% (+120bp y/y); operating income of $213.3M (+8.6% y/y) and net income of $208.2M (+9.6% y/y) benefited from a lower effective tax rate (7.9% vs 10.9% y/y). Diluted EPS of $3.62 (+11.4% y/y) also reflects a smaller share count from buybacks. F5 raised FY2026 guidance to 9-10% revenue growth (from 7-8%) and non-GAAP EPS of $17.21-$17.33 (from $16.25-$16.55), and issued Q4 FY2026 guidance of $870-890M revenue. Cash rose to $1,605.8M (+11.3% q/q).

drivers.explanation: 19% product revenue growth drove 11% total revenue growth: Systems +32% y/y to $240M, Software +7% y/y to $223M; Services grew 3% y/y to $402M.
CEO cited eight consecutive quarters of double-digit product growth, framing it as reflecting F5's role securing hybrid multicloud and AI-driven enterprise infrastructure.
Operating margin held despite R&D growth of 20.8% y/y and G&A growth of 21.5% y/y, as revenue growth (+10.9% y/y) still outpaced total opex growth (+14.4% y/y).
Net income grew faster than operating income because the effective tax rate fell to 7.9% (tax $17,991K / pretax $226,199K) from 10.9% a year ago.
EPS growth (+11.4% y/y) outpaced net income growth (+9.6% y/y) because diluted share count fell to 57.55M from 58.49M y/y, consistent with $501M of buybacks over nine months.
Cash grew as nine-month operating cash flow of $841.4M more than offset $501M of share buybacks, $63.7M of capex, and $47.6M of acquisition spending.
